name: 25_insert_power_plug
title: Plug Power Cord and Cover Cube
summary: A dual-arm robot inserts a power plug, hides a red cube beneath a book, arranges other blocks, and uncovers the cube.
robot: two white robot arms with parallel grippers
setting: an office laboratory with white desks and computer equipment

source.original_prompt: insert white plug into power strip

segments.instruction: Grasp the white power plug lying on the black mat with the right gripper. The camera remains fixed.
Lift and insert the white plug into the power strip socket. The camera remains fixed.
Release the plug and move the right gripper to grasp the green book. The camera remains fixed.
Lift the green book and set it flat over the red cube to cover it entirely. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: hide: red cube covered under the green book

segments.instruction: Pick up the yellow cube with the left gripper and place it onto the pink stand. The camera remains fixed.
Pick up the green cube and move it beside the tape measure. The camera remains fixed.
Lift the book off the table and set it back to its starting spot. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: return: red cube reappears undisturbed on the white table

segments.instruction: Pick up the red cube and place it on top of the yellow cube. The camera remains fixed.
